transcript: Um, I want to talk about a city I visit last year, it is Da Nang. I go there with my family, and we stay in a small hotel near the beach. The weather was very good, so we swim every morning. Also, the food is, the food was really delicious, especially the seafood. I think it is a good place, because people is friendly and the sea is very beautiful. I want to go back there next summer.
